summary.short: Provisional measure creating the REDATA tax regime for data-center services, including AI training and inference, for Brazilian firms building or expanding data centres. Enrolled firms get suspended federal taxes on IT equipment, converted to zero rate after performance commitments. Effective on publication; Article 11-C from 1 January 2026.
summary.long: MP 1.318/2025 amends Lei 11.196/2005 to create the REDATA special tax regime for data-center services, defined to include cloud computing, high-performance computing, and training and inference of AI models. Legal persons implementing data-center installation or expansion projects in Brazil may obtain habilitação from the federal tax authority; IT-product suppliers may obtain coabilitação. Habilitação requires commitments to: offer at least 10% of processing and storage capacity to the domestic market; meet sustainability criteria; source all electricity from clean or renewable sources; keep Water Usage Effectiveness at or below 0.05 L/kWh, verified annually; and invest 2% of purchased-product value in R&D (substitutable by an additional 10%). Commitments are reduced by 20% in North, Northeast and Centre-West establishments. Suspended PIS/Pasep, Cofins, IPI and import tax on IT equipment convert to zero rate after compliance. Non-compliance triggers recovery with interest and fine; capacity-commitment breach leads to suspension, and cancellation after 180 days bars re-entry for two years. Most provisions apply from publication; the Article 11-C suspensions run from 1 January 2026 for five years.
